# Retention Evidence

Decision question: is D30 retention healthy enough to roll the redesigned onboarding flow out to every signup channel?

Blended D30 retention across all signups is 38%, inside the 36-40% band the team treats as healthy. Segmented by acquisition channel, paid-search signups retain at 41% and organic signups retain at 44%, but invite-referred signups — the fastest-growing channel this quarter, 21% of new signups — retain at only 9%. The blended figure looks healthy only because the two large, stable channels dilute the invite-referred collapse.

The next action must name the failing slice explicitly rather than approving a full rollout on the blended figure alone.
